comment: Generic sector templates for the synthetic eval vault. No issuer figures. No per-ticker branches. Fill {name} {ticker} {canary} {form_note} at generate time.

bank.mechanism: a fixture deposit book re-prices faster than the house assumed
bank.stance: The fixture house is that net-interest mix, not fee mix, is the binding watch. Deposit beta is the mechanism. Credit quality is a second-order register item, not the thesis.
bank.flip: The house would flip if the named deposit book re-prices through the assumed band for two consecutive print cycles, or if the fixture credit pulse becomes the binding constraint.
bank.risk1_mechanism: A named fixture deposit book re-prices faster than the house assumed.
bank.risk1_trip: fixture beta above the house band
bank.risk2_mechanism: A fixture consumer book shows early delinquency in the notes, not in SEC tags.
bank.risk2_trip: fixture delinquency print in notes only

insurer.watch: reserve adequacy on a named book
insurer.mechanism: a fixture reserve study lags the house clock
insurer.stance: The fixture house is that reserve adequacy, not top-line growth, is the binding watch. The reserve clock is the mechanism. Catastrophe pulse is a second-order register item.
insurer.flip: The house would flip if a fixture reserve study prints adverse for two cycles, or if the catastrophe pulse becomes the binding constraint.
insurer.risk1_mechanism: A fixture reserve study lags the house clock.
insurer.risk2_mechanism: A fixture catastrophe event is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

reit.watch: occupancy quality on a named portfolio
reit.mechanism: a fixture tenant mix thins versus the house
reit.stance: The fixture house is that occupancy quality, not headline rate, is the binding watch. Tenant-mix thinning is the mechanism. Refinance clock is a second-order register item.
reit.flip: The house would flip if the named tenant mix thins versus the house for two print cycles, or if the refinance clock becomes the binding constraint.
reit.risk1_mechanism: A fixture tenant mix thins versus the house.
reit.risk2_mechanism: A fixture refinance window is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

energy.watch: downstream capture on a named system
energy.mechanism: a fixture refining margin slips versus the house band
energy.stance: The fixture house is that downstream capture, not upstream volume, is the binding watch. Capture slip is the mechanism. Project clock is a second-order register item.
energy.flip: The house would flip if fixture capture prints below the house band for two cycles, or if a named project slip becomes the binding constraint.
energy.risk1_mechanism: A fixture refining margin slips versus the house band.
energy.risk2_mechanism: A fixture project slip is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

enterprise_software.watch: cloud mix quality on a named suite
enterprise_software.mechanism: a fixture cloud attach stalls versus the house
enterprise_software.stance: The fixture house is that cloud-mix quality, not license volume, is the binding watch. Attach stall is the mechanism. Export or FX pulse is a second-order register item.
enterprise_software.flip: The house would flip if fixture cloud attach stalls for two print cycles, or if an export pulse becomes the binding constraint.
enterprise_software.risk1_mechanism: A fixture cloud attach stalls versus the house.
enterprise_software.risk2_mechanism: A fixture licensing or export clock is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

consumer_discretionary.mechanism: a fixture traffic pulse thins versus the house
consumer_discretionary.stance: The fixture house is that traffic quality, not ticket mix, is the binding watch. A fixture traffic pulse is the mechanism. Liquidity clock is a second-order register item on a smaller book.
consumer_discretionary.flip: The house would flip if fixture traffic thins for two print cycles, or if the liquidity clock becomes the binding constraint.
consumer_discretionary.risk1_mechanism: A fixture traffic pulse thins versus the house.
consumer_discretionary.risk2_mechanism: A fixture liquidity window is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

healthcare.watch: medical-cost trend on a named book
healthcare.mechanism: a fixture cost trend runs ahead of the house
healthcare.stance: The fixture house is that medical-cost trend, not membership growth, is the binding watch. Cost-trend slip is the mechanism. Regulatory clock is a second-order register item.
healthcare.flip: The house would flip if fixture cost trend runs ahead of the house for two cycles, or if a regulatory clock becomes the binding constraint.
healthcare.risk1_mechanism: A fixture cost trend runs ahead of the house.
healthcare.risk2_mechanism: A fixture rule clock is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

industrial.mechanism: a fixture channel fills faster than the house assumed
industrial.stance: The fixture house is that dealer-inventory quality, not factory hours, is the binding watch. Channel fill is the mechanism. Project clock is a second-order register item.
industrial.flip: The house would flip if fixture channel inventory fills through the house band for two cycles, or if a named project slip becomes the binding constraint.
industrial.risk1_mechanism: A fixture channel fills faster than the house assumed.
industrial.risk2_mechanism: A fixture project slip is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

consumer_staples.mechanism: a fixture mix shift toward cheaper packs versus the house
consumer_staples.stance: The fixture house is that price-pack architecture, not volume, is the binding watch. Mix shift is the mechanism. Input-cost pulse is a second-order register item.
consumer_staples.flip: The house would flip if fixture mix shifts toward cheaper packs for two cycles, or if an input-cost pulse becomes the binding constraint.
consumer_staples.risk1_mechanism: A fixture mix shift toward cheaper packs versus the house.
consumer_staples.risk2_mechanism: A fixture input-cost pulse is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

materials.mechanism: a fixture cost clock runs ahead of the house
materials.stance: The fixture house is that cost quality, not headline volume, is the binding watch. A fixture cost clock is the mechanism. Permit clock is a second-order register item.
materials.flip: The house would flip if the fixture cost clock runs ahead of the house for two cycles, or if a permit clock becomes the binding constraint.
materials.risk1_mechanism: A fixture cost clock runs ahead of the house.
materials.risk2_mechanism: A fixture permit slip is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

default.mechanism: a fixture mix item thins versus the house
default.stance: The fixture house is that a named mix item, not a headline total, is the binding watch. Mix thinning is the mechanism. A second register item is a clock, not a tagged SEC line.
default.flip: The house would flip if the named mix item thins versus the house for two print cycles.
default.risk1_mechanism: A fixture mix item thins versus the house.
default.risk2_mechanism: A fixture clock is on the register; not a tagged SEC line.

form_notes.20-F: IFRS twenty-F shape. A US-style quarter span may be absent from tagged companyfacts. That absence is a GAP, not a license to substitute an exhibit.
form_notes.10-K/10-Q: Domestic ten-K / ten-Q shape. Prefer tagged companyfacts period labels over headlines.
